body:
I felt this combination was divinely inspired as I woke up with it in my minds eye with that wink of well-being. A prayer of positive karma was uttered before I took 1 large cap. And as an austerity I was not smoking (cigarettes). I meditated and focused on my breathing until I felt that amanita spaciousness. I ate 3 flowers and mostly spent my time in a formless meditation occasionally moving about to exercise my anger from not-smoking.
I felt a swirling purple and pink. And decided to put myself within it.  My lips started burning, any purification my body/mind was going through was centered on my lips and throat. Large chunks of staticky energy were purposefully leaving through my throat chakra.  This reminded me of the importance of Right Speech and how much more fun the path of truth is. I knew a period of ego evaluation was in store.  I continued to leisurely enter the abyss of meditation.  2 weeks worth of recapitulation was underway and I witnessed patiently.  When this process had come to a close, I nourished myself near formlessness. I felt the echinacea had unwinded my body from the residue of sin.  This was a pure sign or casina in itself and I intended to have access to it for later use I imagined it as pink.  This was all very subtle, restrained and enjoyable.
The tail end of the recipe was to be again 1 large beautiful amanita. Waited for the previous spaciousness experienced. Two bowls of dried echinacea  mixed with a small amount of Salvia 10x.  I spent some time with the salvia sign as it is short acting.  Just like buddhists are taught to reflect on the divine qualities of the  buddha.  Salvia heads often reflect on the qualities of salvia while on the drug, which are 1st, inner cleanliness, and something more abstract.  I cant think of the word but I'll make a casteneda reference from Journey to Ixtaln.  Carlos, And Don Juan are sitting around the fire.  And Don Juan speaks of the journey to Ixtaln as something never accomplished yet one must try. Don Juan and Don Genaro are both teary eyed.  I'm speaking of a mood.
Anyway the fun part now begins, the purple and pink swirling take me for another ride and I had a bit of a mental trip on the dual nature of many plants. Purification and mood.  The purple and pink swirling centered around my dick cheney chakra.
The purple and pink swirling centered around my dick cheney chakra.
And wondered about past and future sexual meanderings and the importance of Right Company.  I was becoming disinterested in thought and sex and entered into  an energetic mood of virginity.  I fell asleep and had this vision.
I entered into the house of satan. It was empty, but the mood was reminiscent of Lynch's empty room scenes.  I really wanted a cigarette but I had remembered I was abstaining.  I noticed Some people in the room had smokeless tobacco. A girl came up to me and started to blow me.  The man in the room mentioned how gross the tissue like film around my penis was.  The girl blowing me started to cut my penis from the urethra down. I felt like, 'hey?' and quickly left. The girl was obviously unhappy with me as she hurled many knives at me as I set down along the road.  I called upon help and the knives dropped mid-air like bullets from the Matrix.  The sky became like water and I felt a bubble around me the size of the sky. Allright. I realized I was dreaming and this burst me into wakefullness. (Lucidity is not my strong-point.) I drank some water and felt unpleasant from the echinacea.  Which I visualized as a stream of straw (like dried oats) carrying away my distress. This straw was beautifully golden and wandered through the 5 elements of my  body. I reflected on the dream and learned a lesson about leaving the house of Satan when it is felt to be so.
Overall the fresh echinacea felt nicer than the smoked.  As I am writing this right after the experience I expect to experience of  the dry/ pink/flashing gold  'sign' of echinaceas cleansing effect for the rest of the week.
